text: Alongside its fact-check, TextOS runs a separate check that compares the draft with the brief it was written for. It looks at three things: each point the brief requires is either backed by a statement with a source or left out for a reason a person accepted, the sections the brief requires are present, and the target search query is addressed. A draft goes to preview only when both the fact-check and the brief check pass. Being right and being what you asked for are answered as two separate questions, instead of being blended into one score.
